summary: The root LFW (تَلَافَى) means to repair or set right something that is deficient or inconsistent. It implies correcting a shortcoming or making amends.
lane: 6 تَلَافَاهُ ذ i. q. تَدَارَكَهُ [ He repaired it; a meaning well known]; (S, Msb, K, TA;) namely, a short-coming; or failing, or falling short, of what was requisite, or due; and an inconsistent act. (TA.) You say, هٰذَا أَمْرٌ لَا يُتَلَافَى [ This is an affair that will not be repaired ]. (TA.) And تَلَافَى أَمْرَهُمْ بِالصُّلْحِ [ He repaired their condition by peace, or reconciliation ]. (EM, p. 117.) See دَقَّهُ
